description: This file defines a React component 'AddSmartViewModal' used for creating or editing a 'Smart View' in a web application. It includes UI elements such as inputs, icon picker, predicate builder with tabs, and JSON examples, and manages modal actions like save and cancel.

methods.name: toggleIconPicker
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the icon picker popover.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates input and triggers saving of the smart view, also handles focus if validation fails.
